crossRefs.note: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.
Then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,
Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin…
Yes, you didn’t hear. Yes, you didn’t know. Yes, from of old your ear was not opened, for I knew that you dealt very…
Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by…
The Lord Yahweh has opened my ear. I was not rebellious. I have not turned back.
A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord…
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.
“I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,
Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart, you men of Judah and inhabitants of…
Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn…
Cast away from you all your transgressions, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new…
Israel, return to Yahweh your God; for you have fallen because of your sin.
Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!
“Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from…
The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

translations.web: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.
